# Exudizmono release notes

Running Exudizmono **v0.2.5**, based on OpenFront **v0.34.14-79-ge02eeba6**. [Exact upstream source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/e02eeba66b4801ebae0b686e1b0e4bc03fbf3654).

Choose OpenFront releases above for all 270 published release notes through **v0.34.14**. This main snapshot also contains commits after that tag; it is not a later tagged release. Release-specific branches are labelled individually. No notes for newer versions are presented as installed.

Exudizmono changes below come from this fork’s actual commits. Dates are UTC.

## Exudizmono v0.2.5

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Reduce naval frame bandwidth and bound public lobby capacity. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/a4fd04b339dc11f540f84dfd2d88f7e2a6b252d1)
- Enable protected naval units in public multiplayer and ranked lobbies. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/07cfdafe6f96e0b7dfcced8916f6b2ad600f6296)

## Exudizmono v0.2.4

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Promote approved v0.2.4 release. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/96f771c4dd006bae6f27751a56c87c65b2c9aba8)
- Accept archived players without optional stats so skill results are recorded. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/473a35353b572afd58c6272a506aa0f1b3ec4e9d)
- Hide eliminated player names immediately and normalize clan invite edits. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/308164c36e055ac0eaab7075420201749302bb65)

## Exudizmono v0.2.3

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Refresh release notes and validate public-only skill results. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/155d5d302b1e4afc9f8fe7eab65baa56b78c6df3)
- Prepare full v0.2.3 promotion and fix sidebar CI fixture. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/efc4d5fbe229229105426946f0aab800eca3160a)
- Record branding-only live deployment. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/3ccfe011b2b53359bdd4519f185baa48e79dbce7)
- Brand social share previews as Exudizmono. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/22eca945d39a1833c8f16199be95cfbda5b356f0)

## Exudizmono v0.2.2

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Improve naval purchase tooltips and show multiplayer skill ranks. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/5e09ede90bdb18fc9d389b7c27b03c5f2f86487f)

## Exudizmono v0.2.1

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Enable solo naval units and fair bot and nation fleets. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/5625cea818ced1cf31dc97ccade5ba02da930b65)

## Exudizmono v0.2.0

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Keep preview controls clear and stabilize heavyweight coverage checks. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/4f608bb008dc87eb6db73087473d590414029c26)
- Coalesce naval UI queries and correct independent preview feeds. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/d14529303102e55a07db90e9ff59829397b7da9c)
- Add server-authoritative naval playtest with hidden submarines. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/d3dc60c3128cec019db75808c4e289c9a6aa8915)

## Exudizmono v0.1.9

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Recognize verified Steam and linked sign-in accounts as trusted. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/2c913076cc8e5cedb855e9884bd4f2d9d9e06610)

## Exudizmono v0.1.8

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Refund half of paid building and upgrade costs after voluntary demolition. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/1ec97917bb3f64d978c79ffc15c5eca18253ee30)

## Exudizmono v0.1.7

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Add instant deletion of individual railway connections. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/8bf97991329026d663a87525fefb5e56c9d53681)

## Exudizmono v0.1.6

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Restore independent cosmetic storefront and unread release notifications. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/9fa53684cfb91e5f01c07910eb526e1ebae3187d)

## Exudizmono v0.1.5

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Fix production delivery of release history. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/05ec2df895ee64b16f69b03280e0cf137985e548)
- Include actual untagged upstream changes in release history. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/1253b00d553257c835dc39c2c27a76ba729ab2a0)
- Show verified upstream and Exudizmono release histories. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/6a99ca66492734e3591646e4e785d699fcd39f5c)

## Exudizmono v0.1.4

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Add persistent clan creation and membership management. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/4fc01932dd48ee33eadda53e35378030746a350f)

## Exudizmono v0.1.3

2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Rename leaderboard branding to Exudizmono. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/076920aafa2b8ce5d98e98f165baec76a79a3569)
- Link Exudizmono community Discord in the game. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/1dcfdb69a79c7579e43f79870b49a204a44a04b1)

## Exudizmono v0.1.2

2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02 (UTC)

- Provide schema-compatible own-server clan directory. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/386a92a4b6bcc4afa63a15ec2ca5a98e2989f71d)
- Polish leaderboard mode controls on small screens. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/57ec93ca9f2521ea296a541ee161c2b0521e100f)
- Restore full leaderboards with independent mode skill ratings. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/f4a5c80e311527820bc96245be2c3ae6488ce728)
- Escape player ID hyphen for HTML Unicode-set validation. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/f3069ef30eeb24fae1490ca6b0086f7bf342ce51)
- Fix map asset URLs in inline game workers. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/9777ef56f3969d15bfd6c5739593fede0f7378b8)

## Exudizmono v0.1.1

2026-10-01 (UTC)

- Use encoding-safe separators in profile totals. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/8e859926a7f27c6caf6581309394c2b5c79efdf1)
- Connect game profiles and leaderboards to Exudizmono stats. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/f384a8e7edf98350e8128f3e8ff2a1461ed5f58a)

## Exudizmono v0.1.0

2026-10-01 (UTC)

- Display independent Exudizmono and OpenFront base versions. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/1a3c1484015c3ab19494bee7e0de1f6989a3036d)
- Protect sign-in request logs and document account deployment. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/6e492f83d248327009c1b1684ce606ab488292b9)
- Add persistent accounts and independent provider sign-in. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/91ea9a9e780c528c17be4bfdcc856c7de100c23c)
- Brand Exudizmono and add independent VPS stats backend. [Change](https://github.com/Moonnooo/OpenFrontIO/commit/7973a51703b3d6ea9ba0ae34967ea8b2ad6fc025)

upstream.title: Main snapshot · e02eeba
upstream.markdown:
# OpenFront main snapshot

This is the exact upstream code used by Exudizmono. These 79 commit entries are changes after v0.34.14, not a separately published official release. [Exact base](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/e02eeba66b4801ebae0b686e1b0e4bc03fbf3654).

- Fix solo game start opening the YouTube tutorial on Firefox Android 📺 (#5745). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/e02eeba66b4801ebae0b686e1b0e4bc03fbf3654)
- Tutorial: give a general reason to ally instead of claiming nations make strong allies 🤝 (#5744). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/da2ae74c118ad8b66e8b3ee6339f94adae3a2b2e)
- Smarter nations: 1% boats and a faster early economy 🏝️ (#5741). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/c783e13d5f190cf2ce77a792d7d177a49dc2b505)
- Send past_due subscribers to the billing portal from the store (#5738). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/41e47ff8434ca63c6d0c28050b8ba2113afdb435)
- Telemetry: stop billing a session for expected errors (#5742). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/8bbdc7f09c659d911730ea90fc0de97aaefdf1ff)
- Host joins their lobby with the token that created it (#5728). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/777ee526b0247d3ce34a9e2fbe63b7dd5fb7880d)
- Log "game past max duration" once at prune, not in phase() (#5736). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/00bed4c260b8b70b8d1eb19d60b85870569e312c)
- Log whether winner voters agree on per-player stats (#5717). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/a7a2c8579aaabea869910b53cbf0b3db729932b2)
- fix(docker): keep scripts/replay out of the image build (#5730). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/9956f88661103755b8cffa2e4b533610f1f8c5ed)
- fix(client): eliminate reload white screen with universal dark preload styles (#5622). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/d7bebe40ff92e8ff9688e24071ab5e66eb10dd6d)
- Record each player's spawn tile in their stats (#5718). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/770b7e140f934d67f50fe81732e21c987c2f7d36)
- Replay viewer (#5644). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/602fd0fcbe01b2c304203632734d28c1b93dbe69)
- fix: npm security alerts + dependabot cooldown (#5700). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/f372cdf9451cd8c3dc113aaaf8641e2609e2d3cb)
- Log a rejoin the worker cannot place at info, not warn (#5711). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/241186834f10db73ad0af8307755177a09014f27)
- fix(client): stop Mac Ctrl+click from also attacking (#4918) (#5350). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/5e8d034e032702328bf7a8c2a4576f773d9f612c)
- fix(client): display calculated troop count in mobile attack ratio control (#5381). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/30ee2642e60a1f7d4b39dca6bf63856079f3fbc9)
- fix(telemetry): serialize each event once at admission (#5422). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/c49c560dbf63ae73dc4c0f2168f0403be01e9a79)
- Smarter nations: safer boats, sharper retaliation and pressure on runaway leaders 🧠 (#5685). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/7daa92df69002dbb5b061392eccc1caf1a8a07ad)
- fix(settings): stop Escape bubbling when cancelling keybind capture (#5687). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/15d2aa8c2320810107b03db89a8389361b30cba6)
- fix(chat): reset selected player across phrase and category changes (#5688). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/9b117d14280991991acd94bffd3ed84df71b013e)
- fix(events): use displayName for alliance request confirmation (#5689). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/7535523a687be6d887f0dcf1a5f12b9905b14d3e)
- Adds Vancouver Island map (#5461). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/e1cd75292d3802d8402d2a8ba845db6294ea9469)
- Adds Cape of Good Hope (#5707). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/f611c5241d6cd25e0018145cbf3ebdd1d43328c1)
- Remove AdShield script (#5710). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/a02ec208069be3327f2d705be5d578fb116e3a44)
- Skip build confirm when the pointer is released off the map (#5709). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/09a7231f65ec4eea1f510b8ffde152b179354b07)
- Serialise SharedStyles populates so Firefox never sees overlapping replace() (#5706). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/acdc611158459888fc692e7553d540ff56d30647)
- Close joins terminally when /users/@me rejects the session (#5693). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/5dc09dbd2dde5105d8b403d7b5ddf8d503e04ec2)
- Only log out on a 401 from /auth/refresh (#5698). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/bb4f716ee3a44211189e3f22a9c6dfbc72e0e381)
- Adds Madagascar map (#5641). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/93a136a1e2915ec7bb83e34980ba5836a91f63ee)
- feat: ranked alert - refactoring: isolate alert controller (#5666). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/476a3f4ca6d21fe5ede91320dffafd51fe0d104e)
- Guard ControlPanel.onAttackRatioChange before init() (#5681). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/588320eabbb5dbfb414908f834da08d9321dc59b)
- Use neutral label for Pakistan-administered Kashmir (#5684). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/64b08dc86484e2386aeae3e21128154dd5ce9845)
- fix(nginx): route /api/adminbot/create_pool to a worker (#5680). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/b4748bf50cd59106396566190b22149036f84d9e)
- Telemetry: send errors from 10% of prod sessions, not all of them (#5676). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/4d8608d7e3516bcae5152c75d54f7dd70e23bbb3)
- Telemetry: send every session's errors, only ours; demote expected failures (#5675). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/bdbb10fed1c49f50679e6c4e30ff0c0b5c590f04)
- Faro: every session's exceptions, console warn/error, slimmer measurements (#5674). [Change](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/2eac0382c4bb125b5a659b30834113a8318faee0)

# v0.34.1
*September 14, 2026*

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies
 - Improve trusted lobby message on CrazyGames

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**
- Fixed edge cases in awarding wins and losses — **JB940**
- Fixed various disconnect / desync issues — **JB940**
- Fixed the factory rail preview path direction — **Nicolas Giuliani**
- Preserved null gold in DonateGoldExecution, and cleaned up dead-defender handling with a converge-until-stable loop — **Berk**
- Relaxed the minimum spawn distance after 750 retries on crowded maps — **FloPinguin**
- Re-tally winner votes when the electorate shrinks — **Evan**
- Added per-mode map rotation weights and per-map modifier overrides — **FloPinguin**
- Restored lost per-map team frequencies and fixed the special-lobby frequency fallback — **FloPinguin**
- Reduced Labyrinth's public rotation frequency (6 → 2), and removed Luna and Chopping Block from public rotations — **Evan**

## Steam & Desktop

- Sign in with Steam on the web, and link Steam from the website — **Jish**
- Steam account linking: browser side, `/link` serving, and pending-link expiry — **Jish**
- Steam rich presence and invite handling for the Electron build — **Jish**
- Added an Invite Friends button to the desktop lobby, and gave the web lobby host one too — **Jish**
- Navigate on a mid-match Steam invite instead of leaving the lobby in place — **Jish**
- The Steam rail on the subscription panel and the store — **Jish**
- Custom plutonium amounts on Steam, seeded with the shortfall — **Jish**
- Client checkout on the rail-agnostic endpoint, and an honest subscription panel — **Jish**
- Stopped the subscription panel destroying a granted month — **Jish**
- Let Steam-only accounts through every identity gate, and keep Steam personas instead of discarding them — **Jish**
- Tell Steam players why they cannot sign in, instead of a Turnstile error — **Jish**
- Route desktop Discord/Google login through the browser link flow — **Jish**
- Publish the client capability level in the release descriptor, and make unrecognised update errors gate multiplayer — **Jish**
- Gate every join path (including Detailed View) while a Steam update is pending — **Jish**
- Steam rich presence status frames and map translation keys — **Jish**
- Show the Steam shell version beside the game version, and move the full version string to the footer — **Jish**
- Show the build's commit when it has no tagged version — **Jish**
- An Exit game control for the desktop build, placed in the nav — **Jish**
- Require a real account, not just a session, to link Steam — **Jish**
- Hide the Steam invite button in public FFA lobbies — **Evan**
- Keep the status bar action button clear of the Steam overlay — **Evan**
- Steam's locale is the default language, and the desktop gate's strings are translated — **Jish**

## Trust, Safety & Moderation

- Added trusted-only lobbies gated on account trust tier, with lock indicators on lobby cards — **Evan**
- Every 4th scheduled public game is trusted-only, spaced so open lobbies are always available — **Evan**
- Tell signed-out players to sign in when blocked from a trusted lobby — **Evan**
- Name the required trust tiers in the public lobby listing messages — **Evan**

- Show the ban reason to the banned player — **iamlewis**
- Updated the Terms of Service: purchases, subscriptions, consumer rights, refunds, chargebacks and fraudulent refund claims — **iamlewis**

## Lobby & Social

- Added the Detailed View lobby browser: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, deep-linkable — **Ryan**
- Put the upcoming lobbies in a column under a heading on the homepage — **Ryan**
- Lobby card polish: map zoom on hover, no rim, aligned pills, and no map leaking past rounded corners — **Ryan**

- Show a spectator-specific message during the spawn phase — **FloPinguin**
- Optional territory sorting in the quick-chat player list — **Komyak**
- Focus the other player when a chat message is clicked — **Oscar Robert-Besle**
- Respect Anonymous Names in event messages that name another player — **Berk**
- Clan tags as team names: majority clan, hybrid two-clan names, or normal teams — **JB940**
- Fixed Turnstile error 300030 on join: one challenge per widget — **Jish**

## Clans

- Donate player currency to the clan treasury — **Evan**
- Show clan currency balances inline — **Evan**
- Added Map and Donations tabs to the clan modal, with fullscreen clan map and signed-out UX — **Evan**
- A clan tag picker so you stop guessing your own tag, plus a clearer verified name — **Ryan**
- Fixed clan member search pagination — **Ryan**
- The clan Map tab shows Coming Soon in prod — **Evan**

## Accounts & Profiles

- Support a Creator: a profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links that survive every sign-in flow — **iamlewis**
- Self-service account deletion in account settings, queued for 24 hours so you can change your mind — **Evan**
- Profile dropdown menu in the nav, a bell news button, and a mobile account icon — **Ryan**
- Verified name defaults on for eligible subscribers — **Jish**
- Warn players when their reserved name is running out — **Jish**
- Explain the suffixed name when a bare claim is unavailable — **Jish**

- Restored game ID copying and added a game link button to history cards — **Aotumuri**
- Toast notifications for copy feedback, including on game cards — **Aotumuri**
- Capture transport stats — **Ryan**
- Nudge long-time players to make a purchase; any purchase makes you ad-free for life — **Evan**

## Cosmetics & Store

- Added a cosmetic inventory locker for everything you own, and redesigned the store around shared cosmetic cards — **Ryan**
- Live skin & effects preview: a stripped-down in-game scene right in the store — **JB940**
- Cosmetic packs are now sold as store bundles, and bundle pattern items can name the colour palette they grant — **Evan**

- Removed the dead USD purchase path for cosmetics — **Evan**
- Inline Apple Pay / Google Pay checkout right on store tiles — **Evan**
- Removed direct dollar purchases of cosmetics and flares — **Evan**
- Let a subscriber with a granted month buy a subscription — **Jish**

## Maps

- **Yangtze River**: upside-down-U-shaped pipe river map — **crunchybbb**
- **China** updated to modern borders (with the Amur river mouth); the classic map lives on as **Qing China** — **crunchybbb**
- **Cape Cod**: new map, iconic hook shaped map in massachusetts — **truffle383-byte**
- **Channel Islands**: new map, lateral Californian map with large distant islands — **crunchybbb**
- **Gulf of Mexico**: new map with 15 nations — **LounNight**

## Performance

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**

- Preserved null gold in DonateGoldExecution, and cleaned up dead-defender handling with a converge-until-stable loop — **Berk**

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**

- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**

*September 14, 2026*

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**
- Fixed edge cases in awarding wins and losses — **JB940**

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**

- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**

- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**

- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**

- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**

- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**

- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**

- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**

- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**
- Fixed edge cases in awarding wins and losses — **JB940**
- Fixed various disconnect / desync issues — **JB940**
- Fixed the factory rail preview path direction — **Nicolas Giuliani**
- Preserved null gold in DonateGoldExecution, and cleaned up dead-defender handling with a converge-until-stable loop — **Berk**
- Relaxed the minimum spawn distance after 750 retries on crowded maps — **FloPinguin**
- Re-tally winner votes when the electorate shrinks — **Evan**
- Added per-mode map rotation weights and per-map modifier overrides — **FloPinguin**
- Restored lost per-map team frequencies and fixed the special-lobby frequency fallback — **FloPinguin**
- Reduced Labyrinth's public rotation frequency (6 → 2), and removed Luna and Chopping Block from public rotations — **Evan**

## Steam & Desktop

- Sign in with Steam on the web, and link Steam from the website — **Jish**
- Steam account linking: browser side, `/link` serving, and pending-link expiry — **Jish**
- Steam rich presence and invite handling for the Electron build — **Jish**

- The Steam rail on the subscription panel and the store — **Jish**
- Custom plutonium amounts on Steam, seeded with the shortfall — **Jish**
- Client checkout on the rail-agnostic endpoint, and an honest subscription panel — **Jish**
- Stopped the subscription panel destroying a granted month — **Jish**
- Let Steam-only accounts through every identity gate, and keep Steam personas instead of discarding them — **Jish**
- Tell Steam players why they cannot sign in, instead of a Turnstile error — **Jish**
- Route desktop Discord/Google login through the browser link flow — **Jish**

- Keep the status bar action button clear of the Steam overlay — **Evan**
- Steam's locale is the default language, and the desktop gate's strings are translated — **Jish**

# OpenFront v0.34.6

Published 2026-09-16 (UTC). Release tag is in this fork’s upstream ancestry.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.6) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/d61ebe39f96fe52d2dc3cb6130bd7a1372ebba38)

# v0.34.6
*September 16, 2026*

- fix the "new" maps category — **Evan**
- improver server infrastructure for Steam release  — **Jish**

# v0.34.5
*September 16, 2026*

- Add per-category cosmetics visibility settings — **Evan**
- Increase train spawn rate mid-late game — **Evan**
- Fix header ad overlapping inline pages — **Evan**
- Fix translated inventory tabs overlapping — **Ryan**
- Number queued lobby labels — **Ryan**
- Clean up the New maps category — **RickD004**

# v0.34.4
*September 16, 2026*

- Remove in-game fullscreen button from desktop — **Evan**
- Add option to merge accounts when linking to Steam — **Jish**
- Gracefully handle Steam outages — **Jish**

# v0.34.3
*September 15, 2026*

- Fix ranked matchmaking bugs — **Jish**
- Fix payment error bugs — **Evan**
- Restore the Default color swatch for owned patterns — **Ryan**

# v0.34.2
*September 15, 2026*

- meta: speed up attacks ~10% — **Evan**
- fix(ui): center win modal cosmetics — **Ryan**
- Show a styled "Trusted lobby" tooltip on the lobby card lock icon — **Evan**
- Fix: public team games with 0 teams — **Evan**
- Clarify trusted-lobby rejection wording — **Evan**
- fix(store): bake the live Stripe key into release builds so wallets reach prod — **Evan**
- Add a Classic bot colors graphics setting restoring the v33 palette — **Evan**
- quieter master default, a one-time reset, and audible ambience — **Jish**
- fix(desktop): copied links point at the website, not app://openfront — **Jish**

# v0.34.1
*September 14, 2026*

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies
 - Improve trusted lobby message on CrazyGames

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**
- Fixed edge cases in awarding wins and losses — **JB940**
- Fixed various disconnect / desync issues — **JB940**
- Fixed the factory rail preview path direction — **Nicolas Giuliani**
- Preserved null gold in DonateGoldExecution, and cleaned up dead-defender handling with a converge-until-stable loop — **Berk**
- Relaxed the minimum spawn distance after 750 retries on crowded maps — **FloPinguin**
- Re-tally winner votes when the electorate shrinks — **Evan**
- Added per-mode map rotation weights and per-map modifier overrides — **FloPinguin**
- Restored lost per-map team frequencies and fixed the special-lobby frequency fallback — **FloPinguin**
- Reduced Labyrinth's public rotation frequency (6 → 2), and removed Luna and Chopping Block from public rotations — **Evan**

## Steam & Desktop

- Sign in with Steam on the web, and link Steam from the website — **Jish**
- Steam account linking: browser side, `/link` serving, and pending-link expiry — **Jish**
- Steam rich presence and invite handling for the Electron build — **Jish**
- Added an Invite Friends button to the desktop lobby, and gave the web lobby host one too — **Jish**
- Navigate on a mid-match Steam invite instead of leaving the lobby in place — **Jish**
- The Steam rail on the subscription panel and the store — **Jish**
- Custom plutonium amounts on Steam, seeded with the shortfall — **Jish**
- Client checkout on the rail-agnostic endpoint, and an honest subscription panel — **Jish**
- Stopped the subscription panel destroying a granted month — **Jish**
- Let Steam-only accounts through every identity gate, and keep Steam personas instead of discarding them — **Jish**
- Tell Steam players why they cannot sign in, instead of a Turnstile error — **Jish**
- Route desktop Discord/Google login through the browser link flow — **Jish**
- Publish the client capability level in the release descriptor, and make unrecognised update errors gate multiplayer — **Jish**
- Gate every join path (including Detailed View) while a Steam update is pending — **Jish**
- Steam rich presence status frames and map translation keys — **Jish**
- Show the Steam shell version beside the game version, and move the full version string to the footer — **Jish**
- Show the build's commit when it has no tagged version — **Jish**
- An Exit game control for the desktop build, placed in the nav — **Jish**
- Require a real account, not just a session, to link Steam — **Jish**
- Hide the Steam invite button in public FFA lobbies — **Evan**
- Keep the status bar action button clear of the Steam overlay — **Evan**
- Steam's locale is the default language, and the desktop gate's strings are translated — **Jish**

## Trust, Safety & Moderation

- Added trusted-only lobbies gated on account trust tier, with lock indicators on lobby cards — **Evan**
- Every 4th scheduled public game is trusted-only, spaced so open lobbies are always available — **Evan**
- Tell signed-out players to sign in when blocked from a trusted lobby — **Evan**
- Name the required trust tiers in the public lobby listing messages — **Evan**
- Added a Report Player button to the player panel, feeding the moderation tools — **Evan**
- Show the ban reason to the banned player — **iamlewis**
- Updated the Terms of Service: purchases, subscriptions, consumer rights, refunds, chargebacks and fraudulent refund claims — **iamlewis**

## Lobby & Social

- Added the Detailed View lobby browser: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, deep-linkable — **Ryan**
- Put the upcoming lobbies in a column under a heading on the homepage — **Ryan**
- Lobby card polish: map zoom on hover, no rim, aligned pills, and no map leaking past rounded corners — **Ryan**
- Made public lobby listing one-way for the host — **Evan**
- Standardized WebSocket close codes and stopped reconnect loops — **Neon**
- Show a friend marker in the lobby player list — **Neon**
- Close loudly on worker mismatch instead of hanging the client — **Evan**
- Reap games that have no connected clients — **Jish**
- Restored the menu after leaving a started game in place — **Jish**
- Show a spectator-specific message during the spawn phase — **FloPinguin**
- Optional territory sorting in the quick-chat player list — **Komyak**
- Focus the other player when a chat message is clicked — **Oscar Robert-Besle**
- Respect Anonymous Names in event messages that name another player — **Berk**
- Clan tags as team names: majority clan, hybrid two-clan names, or normal teams — **JB940**
- Fixed Turnstile error 300030 on join: one challenge per widget — **Jish**

## Clans

- Donate player currency to the clan treasury — **Evan**
- Show clan currency balances inline — **Evan**
- Added Map and Donations tabs to the clan modal, with fullscreen clan map and signed-out UX — **Evan**
- A clan tag picker so you stop guessing your own tag, plus a clearer verified name — **Ryan**
- Fixed clan member search pagination — **Ryan**
- The clan Map tab shows Coming Soon in prod — **Evan**

## Accounts & Profiles

- Support a Creator: a profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links that survive every sign-in flow — **iamlewis**
- Self-service account deletion in account settings, queued for 24 hours so you can change your mind — **Evan**
- Profile dropdown menu in the nav, a bell news button, and a mobile account icon — **Ryan**
- Verified name defaults on for eligible subscribers — **Jish**
- Warn players when their reserved name is running out — **Jish**
- Explain the suffixed name when a bare claim is unavailable — **Jish**
- Extracted name resolution into a pure `resolvePlayerName()` — **Jish**
- Shrunk the verified badge and moved it to the name's top-right corner — **Evan**
- Click the player name to copy it, and paste a full profile URL anywhere an ID is expected — **Ryan**
- Restored game ID copying and added a game link button to history cards — **Aotumuri**
- Toast notifications for copy feedback, including on game cards — **Aotumuri**
- Capture transport stats — **Ryan**
- Nudge long-time players to make a purchase; any purchase makes you ad-free for life — **Evan**

## Cosmetics & Store

- Added a cosmetic inventory locker for everything you own, and redesigned the store around shared cosmetic cards — **Ryan**
- Live skin & effects preview: a stripped-down in-game scene right in the store — **JB940**
- Cosmetic packs are now sold as store bundles, and bundle pattern items can name the colour palette they grant — **Evan**
- Effect previews drawn as in-game scenes — **Evan**

- New "embers" nuke-explosion effect style — **iamlewis**

- Let a subscriber with a granted month buy a subscription — **Jish**

## Maps

- Switched the map generator webp library to drop the C compiler requirement — **Juhan Oskar Hennoste**
- Added a map background color override — **Evan**

## Performance

- Engine perf pass: −39% tick cost on a full 30k-tick World game, behaviour-preserving and hash-identical — **Josh Bradley**
- Batched water-nuke terrain deltas into row-span GPU uploads, and optimized the terrain finalize and water graph rebuild — **Evan**
- Reduced water-nuke terrain update spikes — **Aotumuri**
- Preload the map during the lobby so game start reuses it — **ItsTimeTooSleep**
- Nuke trajectory visuals perf — **JB940**
- Fixed nuke jitter and rubber-banding with lerped unit updates — **JB940**
- Fixed WebGL context loss detection in shader compilation — **Jish**

## Graphics, UI & Quality of Life

- Added an in-game tutorial panel: 20 steps from spawn to MIRV, driven by real sim state — **Evan**
- Added the "Evan's Pick" built-in graphics preset — **Evan**
- Alt view now fills territory with translucent relation colors, and colors trade ships by self/ally involvement on either end — **Evan**
