- Fixed RTL rendering of Persian and Arabic text in the help and tutorial UI — **MRGhust**
- The overtime panel now shows first place (player or team) instead of your own share, so spectators and eliminated players get a full readout — **Evan**
- Solo games start offline: the starting overlay shows immediately without blocking on auth — **Evan**

## Audio

- Replaced all 16 wired sound effects with the new commissioned assets, and wired the new music: a looping menu theme on the home page and a looping gameplay track in game — **Evan**
- New cues for victory and defeat, spawn placement, the game-start drum, factory and transport builds, train-station capture, inbound-nuke warnings, and alliance responses — **Evan**

## Server, Infra & Tooling

# v0.34.1
*September 14, 2026*

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies
 - Improve trusted lobby message on CrazyGames

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**

- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**

- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**

- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**

# OpenFront v0.34.3

Published 2026-09-15 (UTC). Historical release: this tag is on a separate branch and is not an ancestor of our main base.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.3) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/222e4078982e6c21c620a69c82de0392c17385bf)

# v0.34.3
*September 15, 2026*

- Fix ranked matchmaking bugs — **Jish**
- Fix payment error bugs — **Evan**
- Restore the Default color swatch for owned patterns — **Ryan**

# v0.34.2
*September 15, 2026*

- meta: speed up attacks ~10% — **Evan**
- fix(ui): center win modal cosmetics — **Ryan**
- Show a styled "Trusted lobby" tooltip on the lobby card lock icon — **Evan**
- Fix: public team games with 0 teams — **Evan**
- Clarify trusted-lobby rejection wording — **Evan**
- fix(store): bake the live Stripe key into release builds so wallets reach prod — **Evan**
- Add a Classic bot colors graphics setting restoring the v33 palette — **Evan**
- quieter master default, a one-time reset, and audible ambience — **Jish**
- fix(desktop): copied links point at the website, not app://openfront — **Jish**

# v0.34.1
*September 14, 2026*

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies
 - Improve trusted lobby message on CrazyGames

# v0.34.0
*September 14, 2026*

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

# OpenFront v0.34.2

Published 2026-09-15 (UTC). Historical release: this tag is on a separate branch and is not an ancestor of our main base.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.2) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/8ab4aa2f57859a596acc0daeb5b26524c564e997)

# v0.34.2

- meta: speed up attacks ~10% — **Evan**
- fix(ui): center win modal cosmetics — **Ryan**

- Fix: public team games with 0 teams — **Evan**
- Clarify trusted-lobby rejection wording — **Evan**
- fix(store): bake the live Stripe key into release builds so wallets reach prod — **Evan**
- Add a Classic bot colors graphics setting restoring the v33 palette — **Evan**
- quieter master default, a one-time reset, and audible ambience — **Jish**
- fix(desktop): copied links point at the website, not app://openfront — **Jish**

# v0.34.1

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies
 - Improve trusted lobby message on CrazyGames

# v0.34.0

## Overview


**Public profiles**

All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**

Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**

Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**

A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**

A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**

Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**

Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

# OpenFront v0.34.1

Published 2026-09-14 (UTC). Historical release: this tag is on a separate branch and is not an ancestor of our main base.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.1) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/a33efb780c4daf7cfb703bb3e8c7ce5d3f014325)

# v0.34.1

 - Reduce number of trusted lobbies
 - Improve trusted lobby message on CrazyGames

# v0.34.0

## Overview


**Public profiles**
All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**
Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**
Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**
A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**
A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**
Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**
Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**

# OpenFront v0.34.0

Published 2026-09-14 (UTC). Release tag is in this fork’s upstream ancestry.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.0) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/1e973bb534b8b37d8d30c80ab27ad1391a7b82da)

# v0.34.0

## Overview


**Public profiles**
All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down mid-late game
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**
Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**
Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**
A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**
A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**
Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**
Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

# OpenFront v0.34.0-beta2

Published 2026-09-11 (UTC). Release tag is in this fork’s upstream ancestry.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.0-beta2) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/1b0c0bc9288e5ad5c53331a971dbde36dd332a5c)

# v0.34.0

## Overview


**Public profiles**
All profiles are public, so anyone can review a player's games — the same approach Lichess and Chess.com use to prevent cheating and teaming. If you'd rather not have that, you can delete your account to hide all your games.


**Meta**

- Gold generation is a bit higher in the early game, but slows down after ~8 minutes
- Attack combat got some tweaks — for most players, most of the time, it shouldn't be very noticeable.  The giant-empire speed bonus is smoothed and capped at roughly 3.3× a small player's rate instead of running away at 9×, so players can no longer be captured extremely fast


**Steam**

- OpenFront is coming to Steam September 17th!
- The Steam client adds exclusive cosmetics, a free month of premium, offline play, achievements, an overhauled audio pass and instant trusted account status (see **Why Steam?** below)


**Smarter nations**
Hard and Impossible nations got a brain upgrade: they now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat, and betray an ally only when it's actually worth it and the retaliation they'd face stays small.


**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**
Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.


**Cosmetics inventory**
A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.


**Detailed View**
A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.


**Support a Creator**
Add your favorite content creator's code to your profile and they get a share of every purchase you make. Creators get their own profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links.


**New maps**
Yangtze River, Cape Cod, Channel Islands and Gulf of Mexico are new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.


## Why Steam?

OpenFront is still free in the browser, and always will be. The Steam client is the same game with a set of things a browser tab can't do:

- Free Steam-exclusive cosmetics, just for playing on Steam
- A month of premium subscription: a verified username, an instant hard-currency bonus, a daily hard-currency reward, public custom lobby hosting (second tier and above) and unlimited ranked games (third tier). Rewards scale with your tier.
- Offline and local play
- Steam achievements
- Maps and assets are already on disk, so games start without waiting on a download
- A full sound and music rework
- Instant trusted account status: Steam accounts skip the trust ladder, so you can join trusted-only lobbies straight away and play games that anonymous griefers can't drop into

Linking doesn't create a second account: your stats, cosmetics and active subscription carry over from your existing OpenFront account to Steam, or the other way round if you start on Steam and later play in the browser.

On the roadmap: LAN servers, an in-game map editor, and Steam Workshop map support.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Simplified the `attackLogic` algebra without changing balance, and folded `attackTilesPerTick` into it — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath, with a lint guard to stop them creeping back — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- Smarter betrayals: Hard/Impossible nations now rank bordering allies by juiciness and betray only when the retaliation they'd face stays safely small — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**
- Fixed edge cases in awarding wins and losses — **JB940**
- Fixed various disconnect / desync issues — **JB940**
- Fixed the factory rail preview path direction — **Nicolas Giuliani**
- Preserved null gold in DonateGoldExecution, and cleaned up dead-defender handling with a converge-until-stable loop — **Berk**
- Relaxed the minimum spawn distance after 750 retries on crowded maps — **FloPinguin**
- Re-tally winner votes when the electorate shrinks — **Evan**
- Added per-mode map rotation weights and per-map modifier overrides — **FloPinguin**
- Restored lost per-map team frequencies and fixed the special-lobby frequency fallback — **FloPinguin**
- Reduced Labyrinth's public rotation frequency (6 → 2), and removed Luna and Chopping Block from public rotations — **Evan**

- Tell Steam players why they cannot sign in, instead of a Turnstile error — **Jish**

## Trust, Safety & Moderation

- Added trusted-only lobbies gated on account trust tier, with lock indicators on lobby cards — **Evan**

# OpenFront v0.34.0-beta1

Published 2026-09-10 (UTC). Release tag is in this fork’s upstream ancestry.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.34.0-beta1) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/5f6c8fad19ab2e7ab5edfc91c9edc8b685f4c293)

# v0.34.0

OpenFront goes to Steam. Plus an in-game tutorial, trusted lobbies, a rebuilt attack meta, a cosmetics inventory, and the engine got 39% faster.

## Overview

**Steam**
Sign in with Steam on the web, link Steam to your existing account, and full desktop-shell support: Steam rich presence, invites through Steam, and subscriptions and plutonium purchases on the Steam rail.

** MIRV Update (test) **
Mirvs don't increase in price, instead there is a 60 second cooldown before another player can launch a MIRV

**In-game tutorial**
A 20-step guided panel walks new players through their first game (spawn, attack, build, ally, nuke), driven by real sim state and adapting to the game's settings.

**Trusted lobbies & player reporting**
Every 4th scheduled public game is now trusted-only, gated on account trust tier. And there's a Report button in the player panel (botting, teaming, bad names, griefing), feeding straight into the moderation tools.

**Attack rebalance**
Attack combat rebuilt around two ratios: your troop ratio and the defender's troop density. Big pushes pay less per tile, turtles on dense land are expensive, and late games keep moving.

**Cosmetics inventory**
A proper inventory locker for everything you own, a redesigned store built around shared cosmetic cards, live in-game previews for skins and effects, and cosmetic bundles.

**Clans**
Donate currency to your clan treasury, clan tags as team names in team games, and Map and Donations tabs in the clan modal.

**Detailed View**
A full lobby browser on the homepage: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, with deep links.

**Performance**
−39% tick cost on a full World game, behaviour-preserving, so your late game just got smoother.

**New maps**
Yangtze River is new, and China got modern borders; the classic map lives on as Qing China.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebuilt attack loss around two ratios (troop ratio × defender density), so overwhelming stacks stop paying the full turtle tax and dense land stays expensive to take — **Evan**
- Smoothed the large-territory bonus with a log-space sigmoid, capped it, and anchored the density weight at a 3/4 stack; nothing under 100k tiles moves — **Evan**
- Pinned attack balance with golden tests and extreme-case scenario coverage, and made `Config.attackLogic` pure — **Evan**
- Pinned the trade-ship and train economy with golden tests — **Evan**
- Replaced `Math.exp/log/pow/atan2` in the core with deterministic DetMath — **Evan**
- New nation attack strategy, juicy(): Hard and Impossible nations now hunt the most valuable bordering rival they can safely beat — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed Hard/Impossible nations ignoring the troop cap when attacking TerraNullius or fallout — **FloPinguin**
- SAMs get dynamic range scaling on upgrade, with WebGL radius previews — **JB940**
- Normalized MIRV warhead speed and removed MIRV map-edge benefits — **JB940**
- Blocked nuke launches in the half-second after accepting an alliance — **JB940**
- Cancel in-flight MIRVs and warheads on alliance acceptance — **Berk**
- Fixed SAMs being unable to target warheads spawned too close — **JB940**
- Fixed the nuke-interception indicator when the target is inside SAM range — **JB940**
- Only annex territory that is actually enclosed: no more losing your whole empire in one tick to a neighbour without an attack landing — **Jish**
- Team games now use the same 80% win threshold as FFA (was 95%) — **Ryan**
- Normalized attack troops to the amount actually deducted — **김준혁**
- Rejected spawn intents based on when they were issued, not when they land, closing the remaining spawn-teleport hole — **Jish**
- Fixed duo/trio/quad team forming so humans get placed together instead of scattered across bot teams — **Sam J Gunner**
- Fixed one-player teams on small public maps — **Aotumuri**
- Impassable terrain now acts like the map edge — **TKTK123456**
- Rails can no longer cross impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed water-nuke pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Trade ship spawn rate is recalculated on each port level roll — **Berk**
- Fixed trains despawning when a track splits — **JB940**
- The game winner now deactivates the Doomsday Clock — **JB940**
- Fixed edge cases in awarding wins and losses — **JB940**
- Fixed various disconnect / desync issues — **JB940**
- Fixed the factory rail preview path direction — **Nicolas Giuliani**
- Preserved null gold in DonateGoldExecution, and cleaned up dead-defender handling with a converge-until-stable loop — **Berk**
- Relaxed the minimum spawn distance after 750 retries on crowded maps — **FloPinguin**
- Re-tally winner votes when the electorate shrinks — **Evan**
- Added per-mode map rotation weights and per-map modifier overrides — **FloPinguin**
- Reduced Labyrinth's public rotation frequency and removed Luna from public rotations — **Evan**

## Steam & Desktop

- The Steam rail on the subscription panel and the store — **Jish**
- Custom plutonium amounts on Steam, seeded with the shortfall — **Jish**
- Client checkout on the rail-agnostic endpoint, and an honest subscription panel — **Jish**
- Stopped the subscription panel destroying a granted month — **Jish**
- Let Steam-only accounts through every identity gate, and keep Steam personas instead of discarding them — **Jish**
- Tell Steam players why they cannot sign in, instead of a Turnstile error — **Jish**

## Trust, Safety & Moderation

## Lobby & Social

- Added the Detailed View lobby browser: every advertised lobby, tabbed by mode, deep-linkable — **Ryan**

## Clans

## Accounts & Profiles

- Support a Creator: a profile panel and `openfront.io/c/CODE` share links that survive every sign-in flow — **iamlewis**

## Cosmetics & Store

## Maps

- **Yangtze River**: upside-down-U-shaped pipe river map — **crunchybbb**

## Performance

- Batched water-nuke terrain deltas into row-span GPU uploads, and optimized the terrain finalize and water graph rebuild — **Evan**

## Graphics, UI & Quality of Life

## Server, Infra & Tooling

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**
- Fixed transport ship troop counts not updating when a hydrogen bomb hits the player — **AmanorsElliot**
- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed the factory ghost radius — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed non-structures being deletable — **unne27**
- Fixed the nuke preview showing teammate SAMs as threats — **Evan**
- Highlight the owner of hovered naval units — **unne27**
- Reduced compact map chance in 1v1 from 50% to 20% — **FloPinguin**
- Removed the ports-disabled modifier from public games — **Evan**

## Ranked & Matchmaking

- Added 2v2 ranked matchmaking — **Evan**
- Added the 2v2 ranked ladder as its own leaderboard tab — **Evan**
- Ranked 2v2 now prefers pairing clanmates as teammates — **Evan**
- Ranked 2v2 games end early when a full team is dead or disconnected — **Evan**
- Increased ranked 2v2 PvP spawn immunity to 1 minute — **Evan**
- Ranked 2v2 uses compact maps only 50% of the time — **Evan**
- Cancel ranked matches that don't fill or fully spawn — **Evan**
- Widened the matchmaking join window and cancel games that start short-handed — **Evan**
- Show the live queue size while matchmaking, and reconnect on silent disconnects — **Evan**
- Handle matchmaking socket close codes per the API contract — **Evan**
- Handle ranked play limits in the client — **Evan**

## 22 New Maps

- **Sol** — Massive map of the Solar System — **RickD004**
- **Russia** — Big-map treatment of Russia — **RickD004**
- **United States** — Large country map built for the new impassable terrain feature — **RickD004**

## Cosmetics & Store

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**

- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**
- Fixed transport ship troop counts not updating when a hydrogen bomb hits the player — **AmanorsElliot**
- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed the factory ghost radius — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed non-structures being deletable — **unne27**
- Fixed the nuke preview showing teammate SAMs as threats — **Evan**

## 22 New Maps

- **Sol** — Massive map of the Solar System — **RickD004**
- **Russia** — Big-map treatment of Russia — **RickD004**
- **United States** — Large country map built for the new impassable terrain feature — **RickD004**
- **Germany** — With state flags — **SpeakIsntThere**

- **Caspian Sea** — Medium sized vertical lake in Central Asia, plays a lot like Black Sea — **crunchybbb**

- **Levant** — Three landmasses surrounding Cyprus — **RickD004**

- **Branching Paths** — Branching fractals form waterways — **NotRocketfish**
- **More than Luck** — Five-leafed clover shaped map, inspired by nuke trajectories — **Patrick Plays Badly**
- **Balkhash** — Pipe shaped lake in Kazakhstan — **RickD004**

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**
- Fixed transport ship troop counts not updating when a hydrogen bomb hits the player — **AmanorsElliot**
- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed the factory ghost radius — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed non-structures being deletable — **unne27**
- Fixed the nuke preview showing teammate SAMs as threats — **Evan**
- Highlight the owner of hovered naval units — **unne27**
- Reduced compact map chance in 1v1 from 50% to 20% — **FloPinguin**
- Removed the ports-disabled modifier from public games — **Evan**

## Ranked & Matchmaking

- Cancel ranked matches that don't fill or fully spawn — **Evan**

## 22 New Maps

- **Sol** — Massive map of the Solar System — **RickD004**
- **Russia** — Big-map treatment of Russia — **RickD004**
- **United States** — Large country map built for the new impassable terrain feature — **RickD004**
- **Germany** — With state flags — **SpeakIsntThere**

- **France** — Large country map — **RickD004**

- **Scandinavia** — Massive European regional map — **crunchybbb**

- **Levant** — Three landmasses surrounding Cyprus — **RickD004**
- **Tierra del Fuego** — Uses impassable terrain — **RickD004**
- **Branching Paths** — Branching fractals form waterways — **NotRocketfish**
- **More than Luck** — Five-leafed clover shaped map, inspired by nuke trajectories — **Patrick Plays Badly**
- **Balkhash** — Pipe shaped lake in Kazakhstan — **RickD004**

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**
- Fixed transport ship troop counts not updating when a hydrogen bomb hits the player — **AmanorsElliot**
- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**

- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed the factory ghost radius — **TKTK123456**

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**
- Fixed transport ship troop counts not updating when a hydrogen bomb hits the player — **AmanorsElliot**
- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed the factory ghost radius — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed non-structures being deletable — **unne27**
- Fixed the nuke preview showing teammate SAMs as threats — **Evan**

## Ranked & Matchmaking

- Handle matchmaking socket close codes per the API contract — **Evan**
- Handle ranked play limits in the client — **Evan**

## 22 New Maps

- **United States** — Large country map built for the new impassable terrain feature — **RickD004**

# OpenFront v0.33.8

Published 2026-08-22 (UTC). Historical release: this tag is on a separate branch and is not an ancestor of our main base.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.33.8) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/d53d6c339fefe0291782e1530242a771a44c9e91)

# v0.33.8
*August 22, 2026*

* fix(net): route the game server's HTTP API through the configured host — **Celant**

# v0.33.7
*August 21, 2026*

* Fix(adminbot): refuse team pins the lobby has no slots for  — **Zixer1**
* Fix(anon): a matchmade team shares one view of everyone else  — **Zixer1**
* Fix(lobby): the team preview honours server-pinned teams  — **Zixer1**
* Feat(adminbot): pin a player to a team after the lobby exists  — **Zixer1**
* Feat(doomsday): team modes climb a higher ladder to the same ceiling  — **Zixer1**
* Feat(doomsday): rotted territory is wasteland  — **Zixer1**
* Feat(adminbot): read the roster of a lobby the bot created  — **Zixer1**
* Join any game to watch without playing  — **Zixer1**
* Remove chipping block from public rotation — **evan**
* Tell users why a duplicate sign-in was rejected — **Celant**

# v0.33.6
*August 19, 2026*

* Ability to replay games from older versions  — **evan**
* Reduce Luna public multiplayer frequency  — **evan**
* Add rate limiting to rejoin requests — **evan**

# v0.33.5
*August 14th, 2026*

* feat(adminbot): featured lobbies — custom label and a longer listing window  — **Zixer1**
* fix: let pinned teammates see each other when anonymous names are set  — **Zixer1**
* feat(adminbot): let create game pin teams  — **Zixer1**
* fix: show the x5 ghost badge when infinite gold zeroes costs — **evan**

# v0.33.4
*August 11th, 2026*

* Added a shortcut to upgrade structures or launch nukes multiple times at once — **U-LF**
* Prevent nukes from firing in same tick — **JB940**

# v0.33.3
*August 10th, 2026*

* Fix las vegas strip right top — **joostlek**
* Fix singleplayer games not saving

# v0.33.2
*August 7th, 2026*

* Prevent translation keys from appearing in the Streaming Now panel — **Aotumuri**
* Doomsday Clock: add territory rot, so a doomed side actually dies — **Zixer1**
* Improve player stats page — **Ryan**
* Anonymised names: drop the "Anon" prefix in-game — **Zixer1**

# v0.33.1

* bugfix: tribes not showing up in leaderboard
* bugfix: replays showing desync error

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**
- Fixed transport ship troop counts not updating when a hydrogen bomb hits the player — **AmanorsElliot**
- Fixed the rail network path length limit and re-added its tests — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed the factory ghost radius — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed non-structures being deletable — **unne27**
- Fixed the nuke preview showing teammate SAMs as threats — **Evan**
- Highlight the owner of hovered naval units — **unne27**
- Reduced compact map chance in 1v1 from 50% to 20% — **FloPinguin**
- Removed the ports-disabled modifier from public games — **Evan**

## Ranked & Matchmaking

- Added 2v2 ranked matchmaking — **Evan**
- Added the 2v2 ranked ladder as its own leaderboard tab — **Evan**
- Ranked 2v2 now prefers pairing clanmates as teammates — **Evan**
- Ranked 2v2 games end early when a full team is dead or disconnected — **Evan**
- Increased ranked 2v2 PvP spawn immunity to 1 minute — **Evan**
- Ranked 2v2 uses compact maps only 50% of the time — **Evan**
- Cancel ranked matches that don't fill or fully spawn — **Evan**
- Widened the matchmaking join window and cancel games that start short-handed — **Evan**
- Show the live queue size while matchmaking, and reconnect on silent disconnects — **Evan**
- Handle matchmaking socket close codes per the API contract — **Evan**
- Handle ranked play limits in the client — **Evan**
- Keep matchmaking games out of lobby reports and salvage invalid entries — **Evan**
- Mint game ids on the server and randomly route create-game across workers — **Evan**
- Removed clan tags from the 1v1 ranked leaderboard (it's an individual ladder) — **Ryan**
- Split the clan tag into its own filterable leaderboard column, with cleaner rank/clan/player cells — **Ryan**
- Fixed an infinite retry at the end of the ranked leaderboard — **Ryan**

## 22 New Maps

- **Sol** — Massive map of the Solar System — **RickD004**
- **Russia** — Big-map treatment of Russia — **RickD004**
- **United States** — Large country map built for the new impassable terrain feature — **RickD004**
- **Germany** — With state flags — **SpeakIsntThere**
- **China** — Qing-China themed country map — **crunchybbb**
- **France** — Large country map — **RickD004**
- **Vietnam** — Skinny country map based on Vietnam War — **crunchybbb**
- **Scandinavia** — Massive European regional map — **crunchybbb**
- **Baltics** — Regional map with multiple islands on edges — **RickD004**
- **Caspian Sea** — Medium sized vertical lake in Central Asia, plays a lot like Black Sea — **crunchybbb**
- **Crimea** — Disputed region between Ukraine and Russia — **crunchybbb**
- **Finger Lakes** — Six skinny lakes connecting to a river, upstate New York — **crunchybbb**
- **Gulf of Guinea** — African map with central Bioko Island — **RickD004**
- **Hecate Strait** — Strait in British Columbia, full of fjords — **Liam Langford**
- **Irish Sea** — Three landmasses surrounding the Isle of Man — **RickD004**
- **Levant** — Three landmasses surrounding Cyprus — **RickD004**
- **Tierra del Fuego** — Uses impassable terrain — **RickD004**
- **Branching Paths** — Branching fractals form waterways — **NotRocketfish**
- **More than Luck** — Five-leafed clover shaped map, inspired by nuke trajectories — **Patrick Plays Badly**
- **Balkhash** — Pipe shaped lake in Kazakhstan — **RickD004**
- **Clearwater Lakes** — Double impact crater lakes in Canada — **RickD004**
- **Las Vegas Strip** — Skinny long map, roads as water and casinos as nations — **crunchybbb**

## Map Fixes & Improvements

- Allow mappers to specify custom tribe spawn coordinates in `info.json` — **FloPinguin**
- Added a tribe name themes system with custom tribes support — **FloPinguin**
- Added tribe themes to all real-world maps, plus custom tribes with spawn coordinates on Los Angeles — **crunchybbb**
- Multiple terrain changes and fixes across maps, plus further map changes for v33 — **RickD004**
- Updated map outlines (no resizing, except Oceania) and updated the Dyslexdria map — **Patrick Plays Badly**
- Small corrections across Dyslexdria, Los Angeles, World Inverted and More than Luck; recategorized More than Luck and Branching Paths as arcade — **Patrick Plays Badly**

- Took v32 maps out of the "New" category to make room for v33 maps; tagged Branching Paths as new — **RickD004**, **NotRocketfish**
- Arcade maps now appear in all playlists — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed a crash on the Indian Subcontinent map — **blon**
- Filled a landlocked lake on the NW island of Four Islands to fix port placement — **blon**
- Prevented AI from placing ports on small lakes — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed map thumbnails resolving by map id instead of display name — **Evan**
- Added an Expand Maps button — **bijx**
- Trimmed archived map names — **Ryan**
- Updated the color mapping location in the map generator README — **Aaron Tidwell**

## Cosmetics & Store

- Added a warship cosmetic effect (gradient/transition recolor) — **Evan**
- Added nuke-trail cosmetic effects with a tabbed effects picker, plus a spiral nuke trail — **Evan**
- Added nuke-explosion cosmetic effects with per-bomb-type shockwave customization, plus a sparkles explosion type — **Evan**

- Show plutonium and caps balances in the store header — **Evan**

## Custom Tribe Names

- Added a Tribes tab to the store to buy and manage custom tribe names — **Evan**

## Accounts, Profiles & Stats

## Performance

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

- Added the Doomsday Clock battle-royale zone gamemode — **Zixer1**
- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock now decays warships alongside troops for doomed sides, and floors the drain at 5% of max instead of wiping to zero — **Zixer1**
- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**
- Doomed warships stay on patrol instead of idling at ports — **Zixer1**
- Added warship veterancy, with updated in-game instructions — **bijx**
- MIRV warheads are now standard nukes: real flight, normal SAM interception, per-type speeds — **Evan**
- Missile silos go on cooldown when launching a MIRV — **Evan**
- MIRV warheads now spawn properly over impassable terrain — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed SAM targeting, range miscalculations and nuke pathing — **JB940**
- Added impassable terrain — **FloPinguin**
- Fixed minimap priority for impassable terrain pathfinding — **FloPinguin**
- Added a custom alliance duration lobby control — **Zixer1**
- Fixed pirating not being disabled when a warship's owner has no port in that body of water — **TKTK123456**
- Fixed transport ships targeting unreachable inland-lake shores — **Navaneeth Prabha**

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

# OpenFront v0.33.4

Published 2026-08-11 (UTC). Historical release: this tag is on a separate branch and is not an ancestor of our main base.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.33.4) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/20c813f06a403da294760fc6089b222179b6a66b)

# v0.33.4
*August 11th, 2026*

* Added a shortcut to upgrade structures or launch nukes multiple times at once — **U-LF**
* Prevent nukes from firing in same tick — **JB940**

# v0.33.3
*August 10th, 2026*

* Fix singleplayer games not saving

# v0.33.2
*August 7th, 2026*

* Prevent translation keys from appearing in the Streaming Now panel — **Aotumuri**
* Doomsday Clock: add territory rot, so a doomed side actually dies — **Zixer1**
* Improve player stats page — **Ryan**

# v0.33.1

* bugfix: tribes not showing up in leaderboard
* bugfix: replays showing desync error

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.

## Gameplay & Balance

- Rebalanced the Doomsday Clock: 10-minute grace period, wave squeeze, slower troop drain, gentler-but-steeper warship attrition — **Zixer1**

- Doomsday Clock judges teams against the same bar as solo sides — **Zixer1**

# OpenFront v0.33.3

Published 2026-08-11 (UTC). Historical release: this tag is on a separate branch and is not an ancestor of our main base.

[Official release](https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO/releases/tag/v0.33.3) · [Release source](https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/commit/ad765842bac44be72a8dc91a9e23369f8fa57744)

*August 10th, 2026*

* Fix las vegas strip right top — **joostlek**
* Fix singleplayer games not saving

# v0.33.2
*August 7th, 2026*

* Prevent translation keys from appearing in the Streaming Now panel — **Aotumuri**
* Doomsday Clock: add territory rot, so a doomed side actually dies — **Zixer1**
* Improve player stats page — **Ryan**

# v0.33.1

* bugfix: tribes not showing up in leaderboard

# v0.33.0

Big one. New gamemode, ranked 2v2, 22 new maps, and mappers can finally block off terrain.

## Overview

**Ranked 2v2**
Ranked isn't 1v1-only anymore. Separate ladder, and it'll try to put you with your clanmates. Lobbies that don't fill or don't fully spawn now cancel instead of wasting your time.

**Login with Google**
Sign in with Google, link it to the account you already have.

**Account usernames**
Claim a username at the account level and play under it with a verified badge. Subscribers get bare names, no suffix.

**Custom tribe names**
New Tribes tab in the store. Buy a name and it'll show up on bot tribes in public games. Boost it to show up more. There's a leaderboard for them.

**Impassable terrain**
Mappers can mark terrain as unpassable. Whole new class of map design, and a few of the new maps already have it.

**Warship veterancy**
Warships get better the longer they survive.

**MIRVs are real nukes now**
MIRV warheads actually fly. Real flight paths, per-type speeds, and SAMs can shoot them down like anything else. Silo goes on cooldown after you launch one.

**Anonymous names**
Lobby setting that swaps everyone's name for an animal name. No collisions, and they're actually memorable.

**22 new maps**
Sol, Russia, United States, France, Germany, China, Vietnam, Scandinavia and more.
